test_communicate_timeout: test that communicate() raises TimeoutExpired and kills the subprocess when the timeout expires
test_popen: test that Popen context manager runs a command and ensures the process terminates after scope exit
run_communicate_with_timeout: run a subprocess with communicate() that kills the process if it exceeds the given timeout
run_popen_context_manager: run a subprocess using the Popen context manager that auto-terminates the process on scope exit
test_run_command: test the run_command utility that executes a command list with a timeout and returns stdout
